# sophosfirewall_service_group (Resource)

Manages a service group (*Objects > Hosts and services > Service groups*). Service groups can be referenced from firewall rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Groups can mix built-in services and services managed by Terraform.
resource "sophosfirewall_service" "app" {
  name    = "app-https"
  tcp_udp = [{ protocol = "tcp", destination_port = "8443" }]
}

resource "sophosfirewall_service_group" "web" {
  name        = "web-services"
  description = "Web traffic"
  services    = ["HTTP", "HTTPS", sophosfirewall_service.app.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service group.
- `services` (Set of String) Names of the member services, e.g. `HTTPS` or a `sophosfirewall_service` name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_service_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
